commitResults.messageBody:
The Developer Guide had drifted from the course's DG requirements:
the manual-testing appendix repeated the User Guide and carried a team
release checklist, implementation sections listed validation rules and
error strings that the User Guide and code already define, several
sentences appeared twice, and unused AB3 undo/redo diagrams remained.

Let's make it explain design instead of restating behaviour:
- Condense the manual-testing appendix and merge its duplicated
  sections. Drop the release checklist, which Testing.md covers.
- Replace per-field validation rules and exact bulk-tag error strings
  with the reason validation lives in the model and shared parser.
- Add short design notes to help, sort, email search, show and
  tag/untag.
- Move Limitations to its own section and the verification roadmap
  under Development workflow. Both anchors are kept so existing User
  Guide links still work.
- Remove duplicated sentences in the saving, import and rename text.
- Renumber user stories in priority order and remap the use cases.
- Expand Common classes and use British spelling consistently.
- Delete unused AB3 undo/redo and tracing diagram sources and images.

No source code or User Guide content changes.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add import folder rule and release checks to DG
commitResults.messageBody:
Section 8 did not say that the packaged JAR only imports files from
inside its own folder, although FileUtil#resolvePath enforces it and
rejects symbolic links. When the manual-testing appendix was condensed
it also lost its checks for startup from a folder with spaces, screen
sizes, response time, User Guide examples and the symbolic-link case.

Let's record both:
- Add a folder-restriction bullet to section 8 that matches
  resolvePath: relative paths resolve from the JAR folder, a path that
  leaves it or passes through a symbolic link is rejected with its own
  message and changes nothing, an absolute path inside the folder is
  accepted, and development runs are unrestricted. Export applies the
  same check.
- Add a Release checks subsection to the manual-testing appendix
  covering startup from a folder with spaces, the folder restriction
  including a symbolic link, screen sizes (NFR05), response time
  (NFR08) and User Guide examples.

Documentation only.
